stop_reason: 100 epochs without a better val TS-near force MAE (EMA)
previous_metric: val force MAE over all validation structures (EMA) [mae_f_kcal_A]

best_all_structures.note: recorded only (no decision uses it since 11-06)

selection.previous_metric: val force MAE over all validation structures (EMA) [mae_f_kcal_A]

export_pick.rule: TS-near best (EMA weights of that epoch)

epochs.metric: val TS-near force MAE (EMA) (kcal/mol/A) = best epoch / scheduler / early stop; all-structure force MAE and energy MAE recorded only

sae.method: atomic reference energies by least squares: E0(Z) = E0_foundation(Z) + lstsq(counts, E_fit - E_foundation) on the training structures (<= 40,000, all structures with a rare element kept) — the formula of mace.data.estimate_e0s_from_foundation (MACE --E0s=estimated); MACE --E0s=average (verified in mace/data/utils.compute_average_E0s: lstsq of total energies on atom counts) would double count the foundation's interaction energy because load_foundations_elements copies the foundation scale/shift. AIMNet2: the same residual least squares with the pretrained atomic shifts zeroed (= aimnet SAE, mode linreg).

hyper.scheduler: ReduceLROnPlateau factor 0.8 patience 10 threshold 0.0 rel (strictly lower = the best / early-stop rule) on val TS-near force MAE (EMA), from epoch 3
hyper.previous_metric: val force MAE over all validation structures (EMA) [mae_f_kcal_A]
hyper.recorded_only: validation force MAE over all structures (mae_f_kcal_A), energy MAE (mae_e_kcal)
hyper.grad_skip: non-finite gradient with finite loss: step skipped; STOP at 10 in a row or 100 in one epoch
hyper.stop: lr < 1e-06 | 100 epochs without improvement of val TS-near force MAE (EMA) | 1000 epochs | 150.0 GPU-h

decisions.FTF-scope: user 11-05 20:5x step 1: the FT-cap train / valid caps are removed; every structure that passes the finetune.Pool filters (level label, finite, even electron count, fmax <= 10 eV/A, exact-duplicate dedupe FT-dedupe, D0 holdout FT-d0hold, truncated Nurion systems FT-leak-trunc) is used. The pilot / capped models are not retrained; their split files and models are not touched.
decisions.FTF-split: membership = finetune.build_split unchanged (drop by tags OR targets(); validation = whole fold_core groups in a seeded order until >= 10 % of the remaining D1 reactions, + Nurion non-target rows of those cores; test = dropped structures whose rxn_ids are all held out) with caps train 0 / valid 0 (no cap) / test 20,000 (FT-cap tier rule and seed). Validation is NOT capped: the existing validation logic has no size limit besides FT-cap (FT_all_s0 had 81,569 validation structures before the cap, fold 4 41,739). Seeds = the capped runs' (valid SEED+100+k / +200+i / +300+d; cap SEED+1000+same), so FT_<k>_full holds out exactly fold k as FT_<k>. Index files = sorted int32 store row ids.
decisions.FTF-g4: G-4 (kind al_ts, $MLT/dft/gen_G4.extxyz) is included iff the file exists and results/G4_report.json says complete at data-build time (finetune with_al rules: G4 read last, dedupe after the base inputs, hold_al, tier 1); otherwise 'G-4 not used' is recorded. A running training keeps its pinned split.
decisions.FTF-train: AIMNet2 as finetune.train_aimnet: released aimnet2_wb97m_d3_0 weights (parity check vs the yaml build), atomic shifts zeroed, NaN species rows of afv -> 0, D3 head = B3LYP-D3(BJ) (s8 1.9889, a1 0.3981, a2 4.4211), molecular charge input, E0 (SAE) by least squares on <= 40,000 training structures (all with a rare element), MTLoss energy_loss_fn (ew 1) + peratom_loss_fn forces (fw), RAdam wd 1e-8 (shifts 0), batch 64, torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_value_ 0.4 (the existing value: element-wise value clipping, not norm). Loader: per epoch the shards in a seeded order (rng [train_seed, epoch]); a shard's training rows are gathered from the memory-mapped .npy files (next shard prefetched in a thread), sorted by atom count after a seeded shuffle, cut into batches of <= 64 (padding to the batch maximum, numbers 0 = padding as aimnet merge_groups), batch order shuffled. Validation rows are gathered once (exact-size batches of 128, as before).
decisions.FTF-ema: weight EMA 0.99 updated after every optimizer step (all parameters incl. shifts; torch._foreach_lerp_); validation and the exported model use the EMA weights; best_ts_ema.pt = the EMA weights FTF-export picks (TS-near selection metric).
decisions.FTF-sched: selection metric (FTF-sel, user 11-06) = validation TS-near force MAE (kcal/mol/A, mean |dF| over Cartesian components of real atoms of the TS-near validation structures) with EMA weights (sel_metric(rec) = rec['mae_f_ts_kcal_A']); it drives ReduceLROnPlateau (factor 0.8, patience 10, threshold 0 rel = strictly lower), best-checkpoint selection (strictly lower) and early stopping, so all three share one improvement definition. Validation force MAE over all structures and energy MAE (training frame, kcal/mol) are recorded only. Before 11-06 the metric was the all-structure force MAE (runs migrated mid-training record switched_at_epoch and previous_metric). Warmup: epochs 0-2, lr linear per optimizer step 1e-5 -> 1e-4; the plateau scheduler steps from epoch 3 on; right before its first step scheduler.best = min(scheduler.best, best TS-near of epochs 0-2), so the scheduler's best is the same value as the best-checkpoint / early-stop best.
decisions.FTF-sel: user 11-06: best checkpoint, ReduceLROnPlateau and early stop use the validation TS-near force MAE (EMA). Resume of a last.pt written by the old code (no TS fields): best_ts_epoch / best_ts_metric = first strict argmin / min of mae_f_ts_kcal_A over the history records (records without it skipped); early-stop counter = last epoch - best_ts_epoch; the current lr is kept; scheduler.best = best_ts_metric, num_bad_epochs = min(patience, number of epochs after best_ts_epoch at which the scheduler stepped (epoch >= 3)) (= min(since-best, patience) whenever best_ts_epoch >= 2), cooldown_counter 0, so with mode min / threshold 0 rel a stale run reduces the lr at its next non-improving epoch. Weights of the historical TS-near best exist only when best_ts_epoch is the epoch of the old best_ema (all-structure best) or the last epoch (EMA of last.pt); else ts_best_weights = 'not retained (epoch N)'. From the switch on, best_ts_ema (EMA at the best TS-near metric seen) and best_ts_sw_ema (best TS-near among the epochs evaluated after the switch) are kept in last.pt; an epoch after the switch that beats best_ts_metric becomes the best (weights kept). The old best_ema.pt is renamed best_ema_allF_legacy.pt at the migration and is never exported.
decisions.FTF-export: export weights (final train export and the interim `export` command): the TS-near best if its weights are kept; else the best TS-near since the switch; else (no epoch evaluated after the switch) the saved candidate (old all-structure best_ema or last-epoch EMA) with the lowest recorded TS-near metric. export_epoch / export_metric (TS-near) / export_rule go to the card and the train json. The all-structure best is never exported.
decisions.FTF-stop: stop when lr < 1e-6 after a scheduler step, or 100 epochs without a better validation TS-near force MAE (FTF-sel), or 1,000 epochs, or the GPU-h cap; then export the FTF-export weights (stop.json keeps the reason so a resubmit goes straight to export).
decisions.FTF-budget: GPU-h = wall-h of the train command (finetune.Budget, budget.json, summed over attempts). For *_full runs the 12 h target / 24 GPU-h STOP of FT-budget is replaced by a 150 GPU-h cap (user 11-05 20:5x): no epoch is started when it would end past 150 GPU-h, and a cap reached mid-epoch drops that epoch; both are a normal stop (export, exit 0), not exit 3.
decisions.FTF-fw: force weight: --fw if given; else the lead's $MLT/pipeline/ft_abl_choice.json ('fw', or 'choice' -> baseline 0.2 / fw1 1.0 / fw5 5.0); else PIPELINE_STATE.json params ft_abl_choice / ft_train_args (when ft_abl_cand is AIMNet2); else 1.0 (no FT-abl decision). The value is pinned in run_key.json at the first start; a later decision is recorded but does not change a started run (restart = --force).
decisions.FTF-resume: checkpoint every epoch (last.pt: model, EMA, optimizer, scheduler, epoch, optimizer step, TS-near best metric / epoch + its EMA weights, best-since-switch metric / epoch + weights, selection record, history; atomic; best_ts_ema.pt is rewritten from that copy after last.pt, and again right before export, so weights and recorded epoch always agree). lock.json is released on every exit (SIGTERM from scancel / the wall -> exit 143 through the finally; a job killed without it leaves a lock that blocks a new job for 900 s after its last heartbeat). A resubmit resumes; the run key (split fingerprint, store, lr, ew, fw, batch, EMA) is pinned, a different key = STOP (--force moves the run dir aside, never deletes). The trainer pauses (exit 2) when the next epoch would end past --wall-h of this job.
decisions.FTF-selfcheck: at every start: split meta (C-2 pass, inputs complete, store fingerprint), index overlap, the first training shard (atom count, elements, finite arrays), one training batch forward + backward (finite loss and gradients, no optimizer step) and one validation batch with the EMA model (finite energies / forces); any failure = STOP (exit 3) before the E0 fit and training.

export_rule: TS-near best (EMA weights of that epoch)
